label: Bible Study
prompt: There is a way which _____ right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verse: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
note: A proverb so important it appears twice — again word for word in chapter 16.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be _____, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verse: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
note: Everything else may shake, but believers receive a kingdom which cannot be moved.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then she let them down by a _____ through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
verse: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
note: Rahab's house was built into Jericho's wall, so the spies' escape route was simply a cord out her window.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy _____; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verse: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
note: Paul's 'O death, where is thy sting?' in 1 Corinthians 15 echoes this taunt of death.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and _____ for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.
verse: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.
note: After the lions' den, King Darius decreed that Daniel's God is 'the living God, and stedfast for ever' — no 'a' in the KJV.
